facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Tom was now a hero. He made fence painting fun. Attitude changes everything. Work can feel like play.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Tom Sawyer had become the most famous boy in the whole town. He found treasure, saved a man, and had amazing adventures. But his greatest trick was making fence painting seem like fun. Work can feel like play when you change the way you see it. Tom taught everyone that attitude is more important than the task. A boring chore can become an adventure with the right mindset.
facts.Word cards: hard work = 열심히 하는 것 / fun = 재미있는 / attitude = 마음가짐 / can be = ~일 수 있다
